name: perse-updater-workspace
description: Build workspace for perse-updater — an out-of-tree DSH plugin of Persevere with DSH. The installable package lives in packages/perse-updater.

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run codegen && npm run bundle
scripts.pack: npm run build && npm pack --workspace perse-updater
scripts.test: npm run build && node scripts/verify-versions.mjs && node scripts/verify-client-bundle.mjs
